skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of natural resource economics including concepts, classification of natural resources, cost recovery, supply-demand in natural resource markets, optimal use, efficiency, and sustainability.
Analyze various types of natural resource policies aimed at optimizing and sustaining resource use.
Analyze the market for natural resources and its impact on economic efficiency.
Conduct cost-benefit analysis for natural resource projects.
Understand and apply principles of economic sustainability in natural resource management.
Work effectively in groups to solve problems related to natural resource economics.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently and apply knowledge to real-world problems.
Prepare and deliver presentations on natural resource economics topics.
